scope: Thunderbird and Chrome now work the same in the background as with a window.

topics.title: Chrome in the background
details: Run the browser in the background now uses the same Chrome as before. Its window is kept out of sight.
It is not on the screen, the taskbar or Alt+Tab. Your keys stay in Voice Companion.
Google search and YouTube now work in the background too.

topics.title: Thunderbird in the background
details: Email no longer waits until you press Alt+Tab. Mail connects on its own, even when Thunderbird is hidden.
Close Voice Companion and start it again. Mail connects on its own.
After an update, mail connects again within a few seconds.

topics.title: YouTube
details: Videos no longer say something went wrong when Chrome runs in the background.
